title: Scope & applicability
summary: Country-baseline assertions must preserve who, where, when, and which scheme they concern.

sections.label: Fields to establish
items: Jurisdiction and subnational region where relevant.
Source authority and exact supporting passage.
Classification scheme, issuer, and version where relevant.

sections.label: Unknown terminology
sections.text: Confirm project-specific terminology with its owner before designing a schema or integration around it. Do not silently expand an unfamiliar acronym.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Information narrowed by a source qualifier remains narrow through ingestion, graph representation, serving, and documentation.

catalog.applicability: Use when a source statement is narrowed by jurisdiction, region, population, period or classification scheme, and that narrowing must survive ingestion, graph representation, serving and documentation. Use it also before designing a schema or integration around unfamiliar project terminology.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
